scope: Task 0T unmodified Takram stock input in the Task -1R LuBirth opening mirror. This decision does not evaluate the V3 adapter.

checks.evidence: The visual E2E independently recomputes Task -1R Earth/camera matrices at all four progress values and matches all camera position, camera matrix, and Earth matrix elements to 1e-6.
At every frame telemetry reports the native BSM, temporal-upscale, and AerialPerspective paths enabled, with a valid LuBirth world-to-ECEF bridge and no transform fallback.
Raw captures contain a clean opaque Earth while full captures show one atmosphere-composited Earth limb; there is no missing asset, double composer, or whole-frame black output.

Across 0.00/0.06/0.12/0.18, neither raw nor full output contains a readable stock cloud volume in the LuBirth space-view framing. The thin violet/blue limb is native atmosphere, not a white cloud shell.
No full capture contains a continuous bright-white cloud rim.

classificationRationale: The upstream near-ground stock control passes with the same renderer fingerprint and assets, while this opening uses the known unsupported stock envelope: cube-sphere local weather mapping, local repeat [100,100], default 0.75–8 km layers, and a space-view/global framing. The absence of a readable stock cloud volume is therefore input/mapping/framing-specific, not evidence of an input-independent native depth, BSM, resolve, or AerialPerspective failure.
